execution.reason: Candidate first to stop without paying for a control if the candidate, mechanism evidence or reserve gate fails; not randomized or unbiased estimation.
execution.servedModel: unattested unless the executor records an authoritative identifier
execution.timeoutComparedWithHistory: 600 seconds instead of 1200; both new arms identical; historical costs are references only

budget.tokenLimitMode: between-call-stop-lines; not a provider hard cap

requires: complete routed final usage and valid timing
actual successful Skill read and delivered hash verified
pre-production discriminating receiver probe observed in public tool evidence
no observed power, configuration or integrity anomaly
secondCallAdmission.rule: Stop at one if any value reaches its threshold or a required condition is false/unknown; no borrowing, extra call or retry.

budget.overshoot: A running call may exceed any token stop line before final counters arrive. Check and report exact overshoot; do not clamp. Cold cache can exhaust a line in the first call. A hard token ceiling is not supported by this executor.
budget.durationScope: Executor duration only. Setup, grading, replay and human review are separate; no promise that all work finishes in 20 minutes.

historicalBudgetBasis.explanation: No v4.1 live sample exists. Neither doubled v4 nor the historical original/v4 pair estimates a stable new paired effect. Cached input is included in total input.

observedRequires: Successful actual command reading the delivered Skill, with identifiable returned guidance; file delivery alone is insufficient

Before the final production receiver decision: executable public evidence distinguishing at least two plausible receiver choices, anchored in API/caller or independently exercised supplied-function behavior
Submitted regression compatibility and retained tool results support the chosen call convention; a prose assertion alone is insufficient
mechanism.ifMissingOrUnknown: Stop at one even if functional checks pass; retain functional success separately from unsupported mechanism.

decisionTable.when: Candidate functional failure or new failing check
Incomplete usage, execution/routing/timing/integrity/power error, budget or admission line reached
Candidate correct but mechanism evidence missing or ambiguous
Candidate passes all checks with observed mechanism; control has a verified actual Skill read and complete evidence, but fails the receiver behavior or its invalid regression witness
decisionTable.result: expected contrast observed in this development pair only

decisionTable.when: Both complete and pass all checks
decisionTable.result: no discriminating contrast; no claim the Skill caused a fix

decisionTable.when: Control fails for an unrelated reason, has no verified Skill read, or evidence is incomplete
decisionTable.result: inconclusive for the targeted mechanism; keep all costs

acceptance.costRule: Report all five totals and per-arm/per-success values; every increase is visible. Zero successes has null per-success cost. Mechanism evidence is not an efficiency claim.

stops.observedAnomalyInFlight: Latch the anomaly, retain current call/partial usage, never start another. Existing between-call guards do not guarantee immediate cancellation of an in-flight call.
stops.pause: Do not auto-resume, complete the pair or spend the unused slot after a stop. Return retained evidence for a new decision.

retain: native call ledger, before/after budget snapshots and actual invocation count
full original delivery, supplied-test integrity, submitted regression and diff
6-check outcome plus separate 18-check replay and registered witnesses
public command chronology and observable mechanism evidence; no private reasoning analysis
all final, partial or unknown usage plus wall/monotonic timing evidence
all failures, overshoots, cancelled work and stopped prefix
evidence.privacy: Retain original private seals; any public redacted export records source/export provenance without rewriting original receipts.
evidence.reproducibility: Replay retained outcomes, checks, order and costs; a fresh model generation is not deterministic.

executionPrerequisites: Explicit human authorization for this concrete two-call proposal; none exists now
Freeze a fresh one-task bench/request/ordered preview and immutable runtime before execution; input preparation must be previewed and backed up
Implement a single-use controller enforcing the candidate-first gates and reserve thresholds; test all stop branches with injected executors before any model invocation
Check current CLI/model/settings and power without a paid readiness call; changed settings require a revised preview
Use matrix-derived project Skill paths, pin common diff helper and keep reference/failure/held-out artifacts out of both model workspaces
No generic two-arm native launch can bypass the after-candidate gates; no automatic continuation after interruption
